reviewNotes: Direct English/Romanian fidelity and editorial review of chat notifications and command help. Character-gender assumptions removed; slash command syntax /help commandName and emote token [126] retained. Square-bracket argument descriptions are help prose, not executable identifiers. Chat_Baby deferred pending inspection of its dynamic sex/pronoun arguments. Currency amounts unchanged numerically; glossary Galaxy Sword/Lost Book/Qi names applied.
